children: Organigram Global Inc. (
) ("Organigram") and Aurora Cannabis Inc. (

) ("Aurora") today announced that they have filed a Joint Management Information Circular (the "Circular") for the special meetings of their respective shareholders, each to be held on Wednesday, December 23, 2026 (collectively, the “Meetings”). The Circular relates to the previously announced arrangement agreement between Organigram and Aurora dated November 2, 2026 (the “Arrangement Agreement”).
The Arrangement

Under the terms of the Arrangement Agreement, Organigram will acquire all of the issued and outstanding Aurora common shares (the “Aurora Common Shares”) by way of a plan of arrangement (the “Arrangement”) for consideration valued at C$7.80 per share. Each Aurora shareholder may elect to receive, for each Aurora Common Share, (i) C$7.80 in cash, (ii) 5.8626 Organigram common shares (the “Organigram Common Shares”), or (iii) C$3.75 in cash plus 3.0431 Organigram Common Shares, subject, in the case of (i) and (ii) to proration.

The consideration represents approximately a 93% premium to Aurora's unaffected closing share price on August 10, 2026, and approximately a 21% premium to the implied value of the Curaleaf hostile bid (the “Curaleaf Hostile Bid”) as of November 2, 2026, which was unanimously rejected by Aurora’s Board of Directors (the “Aurora Board”). The transaction is anticipated to be completed in January 2027, subject to receipt of all required court, shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Reasons to Support the Arrangement Agreement

Organigram and Aurora expect that the Arrangement will establish a global cannabis leader with leading positions in Canada, Europe and Australia, supported by Organigram’s strategic shareholder, BT DE Investments Inc. (“BAT”), a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of British American Tobacco p.l.c. The combined company is expected to have a platform with greater scale, broader capabilities, financial strength and international reach, bringing together Organigram's recreational cannabis leadership, production network, research and development platform and European medical commercial operations with Aurora's global medical cannabis leadership, established international presence, and EU-GMP certified manufacturing capabilities.
The anticipated benefits of the Arrangement include the opportunity for shareholders to participate in, and benefit from:
Establishing a Global Cannabis Leader

with a scaled, Canadian-headquartered global cannabis platform with leading positions in five nationally legal cannabis markets – including Canada, Germany, Poland, Australia and New Zealand – and meaningful operations in other key markets;
A Combined Company with an Industry-Leading EU-GMP Platform with Significant Production Capacity

, including five EU-GMP production and distribution sites expected across Canada and Germany, providing certified supply capacity and a combined cultivation capacity of approximately 170,000 kg per annum across 14 production, research and distribution sites. The combined platform is also expected to support faster cash conversion, resulting in lower investment in inventory and improved working capital efficiency;
Premium Medical Revenue Mix That Supports Sustainable Growth and Margins

, with the majority of pro forma revenue expected to be derived from higher-margin international medical channels, which command structurally better pricing than the Canadian recreational market, supported by Organigram's Canadian recreational cannabis leadership as a stable commercial base and a proving ground for product innovation;
Meaningful Synergies

of more than C$50 million annually, driven by cross-selling opportunities, procurement scale, consolidated distribution, public company expenses, and routing international demand to the lowest-cost production asset across the combined network. Aurora shareholders who retain Organigram Common Shares have the opportunity to participate in the value of such synergies to the extent realized;
Committed Financing
, with the cash portion of the consideration fully financed through a combination of cash on hand, a private placement from BAT, and Organigram’s credit facilities with ATB Financial (“ATB”);
Enhanced Scale and Capital Markets Profile
, including improved trading liquidity and access to capital; and
High Likelihood of Completion

, as the Arrangement is only subject to a limited number of customary conditions and is not subject to any financing or due diligence condition. Aurora and Organigram believe that meaningful regulatory challenges are unlikely given the complementary nature of the two operations.

For Aurora shareholders, the Arrangement also provides compelling immediate value, meaningful choice in how they receive their consideration – with the option to elect cash, Organigram shares, or a combination of both, subject to proration – and the opportunity for continued participation in the future growth and value creation of the combined company. Aurora shareholders are expected to hold approximately a 37% pro forma economic interest and a 41% voting interest of the combined company on a fully diluted basis.

The Aurora Board has determined that the Arrangement is superior to the Curaleaf Hostile Bid, which the Aurora Board and the independent Special Committee of the Aurora Board (the “Special Committee”) have twice unanimously determined to be financially inadequate.
Aurora Shareholder Meeting

Aurora will hold its virtual-only special meeting of shareholders (the “Aurora Meeting”) via live webcast, accessible at www.meetnow.global/MQAVTRW, on Wednesday, December 23, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. Toronto time. Aurora shareholders will not be able to attend the meeting in person.
At the Aurora Meeting, Aurora shareholders will be asked to consider and vote
FOR
a special resolution (the “Arrangement Resolution”) approving the plan of arrangement under section 288 of the
Business Corporations Act

(British Columbia) involving the acquisition by Organigram of all of the issued and outstanding Aurora Common Shares. The full text of the Arrangement Resolution is set forth in Appendix A of the Circular, which is available on Aurora’s SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca and EDGAR profile at www.sec.gov. The Circular is being mailed to all persons required to receive a copy under applicable securities laws. In addition, persons who have previously consented to electronic delivery by providing their email address to their intermediary will also receive an electronic copy of the Circular.

Aurora shareholders can vote by proxy in advance of the Aurora Meeting and online during the Aurora Meeting. Non-registered shareholders who have not duly appointed themselves as proxyholders may still participate in the Aurora Meeting as guests. Guests will be able to listen to the Aurora Meeting but will not be able to vote or submit questions.
Additional online voting instructions are available at www.voteyesaurora.com.
Organigram Shareholder Meeting

Organigram will hold its virtual-only special meeting of shareholders (the “Organigram Meeting”) via live audio webcast, accessible at https://virtual-meetings.tsxtrust.com/2000 using the meeting password “ogi2026” (case sensitive), on Wednesday, December 23, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Toronto time. Organigram shareholders will not be able to attend the meeting in person.

At the Organigram Meeting, Organigram shareholders will be asked to consider and vote FOR an ordinary resolution (the “Organigram Share Issuance Resolution”) approving the issuance of the Organigram Common Shares issuable pursuant to the Arrangement and Organigram securities issuable pursuant to the concurrent private placement of Organigram securities to BAT. The full text of the Organigram Share Issuance Resolution is set forth in Appendix B of the Circular, which is available on Organigram’s SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca and EDGAR profile at www.sec.gov. The Circular is being mailed to all persons required to receive a copy under applicable securities laws.

Organigram shareholders can vote by proxy in advance of the Organigram Meeting and online during the Organigram Meeting. Non-registered shareholders who have not duly appointed themselves as proxyholders may still participate in the Organigram Meeting as guests. Guests will be able to listen to the Organigram Meeting but will not be able to vote or submit questions.
Additional online voting instructions are available at www.organigramXaurora.com.
Unanimous Board Recommendations
The Aurora Board unanimously recommends that Aurora shareholders vote
FOR
the Arrangement Resolution.
The Board of Directors of Organigram (the “Organigram Board”) unanimously recommends, with representatives of BAT abstaining in respect of the BAT private placement, that Organigram shareholders vote
FOR
the Organigram Share Issuance Resolution.

All directors and executive officers of both Organigram and Aurora that hold common shares, as well as BAT, have entered into voting support agreements and have agreed to vote their shares in favour of their respective resolutions.
Both Boards made their respective determinations after receiving fairness opinions from their financial advisors.

The Arrangement follows an extensive process overseen by the Special Committee, comprised exclusively of independent directors, which evaluated all available alternatives, including Aurora remaining independent and the current Curaleaf Hostile Bid, and unanimously determined that the Arrangement is in the best interests of Aurora and that the benefits of the Arrangement to Aurora and the Aurora shareholders outweigh, and are superior to, the Curaleaf Hostile Bid.
Vote Today in Advance of Proxy Voting Deadline

To ensure that shareholder votes are counted at the Meetings, Aurora and Organigram shareholders should complete and submit their form of proxy or voting instruction form as soon as possible but not later than 9:00 a.m. (Toronto time), in respect of the Organigram Meeting, and 9:30 a.m. (Toronto time), in respect of the Aurora Meeting, on December 21, 2026.

Aurora and Organigram are in the process of mailing the Circular to their respective shareholders. Voting instruction forms and control numbers are expected to be available to Aurora shareholders and Organigram shareholders in the coming days. If you have not yet received your voting instruction form, please contact your broker directly to obtain your control number so that you can vote online.

About Organigram

Organigram Global Inc. is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market and the Toronto Stock Exchange (“TSX”). The Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, Organigram Inc., is a licensed cultivator and processor. Through its acquisition of Sanity Group GmbH ("Sanity Group"), Organigram participates in the German medical cannabis market and other emerging markets within Europe. Organigram is focused on producing high-quality cannabis for adult consumers, as well as extending the Company's global footprint. Organigram has also developed and acquired a portfolio of cannabis brands, including Edison, Big Bag O' Buds, SHRED, Monjour, Tremblant, Collective Project, Trailblazer, BOXHOT and DEBUNK. Through its acquisition of Sanity Group, Organigram's European brands include Vayamed, avaay, ZOIKS, Endosane Pharmaceuticals, VAAY, and Grashaus Projects. Organigram operates facilities in Moncton, New Brunswick and Lac Supérieur, Quebec, with a dedicated edibles manufacturing facility in Winnipeg, Manitoba. The Company also operates two additional cannabis processing facilities in Southwestern Ontario; one in Aylmer and the other in London. The facility in Aylmer houses best-in-class extraction capabilities, and is optimized for formulation refinement, post-processing of minor cannabinoids, and infused pre-roll production. The facility in London will be optimized for labelling, packaging, and national fulfillment. The Company is regulated by Health Canada under the Cannabis Act and the Cannabis Regulations.
About Aurora

Aurora is a global leader in medical cannabis, dedicated to improving lives through scientific expertise, proven performance, and a deep commitment to patient care. Aurora serves medical markets across Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand with a portfolio of trusted, leading brands including Aurora®, MedReleaf®, Pedanios®, IndiMed™, San Raf®, and Whistler Medical Marijuana Corporation®. With world-class GMP-certified manufacturing facilities in Canada and Germany, and a team of industry-leading professionals, Aurora continues to expand its global footprint and deliver consistent, high-quality cannabis products with the purpose of Opening the World to Cannabis™.
Learn more at www.auroramj.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
Aurora's common shares trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market and TSX under the symbol "ACB".
